topic: Capstone Usability Testing, Iteration, Accessibility, and Handoff
learningObjectives: Evaluate the capstone prototype through usability testing.
Prioritize findings and iterate on the design.
Prepare accessible designs and implementation-ready developer handoff.

activities.title: Usability Test Planner
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a focused usability test.

content.concept: Usability testing observes users completing representative tasks to uncover interaction problems.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Finding Prioritizer
activities.instruction: Evaluate usability findings using severity, frequency, and task impact.

content.concept: Usability findings can be prioritized using factors such as severity, frequency, and impact on task completion.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

scenarios.finding: Most participants cannot identify the button required to complete the main task.
One participant dislikes the shade of a decorative illustration.
Several participants hesitate briefly because a secondary label is unclear.
Users are prevented from submitting invalid information and receive clear correction guidance.

activities.title: Accessibility Check
activities.instruction: Match each accessibility barrier with the appropriate design improvement.

content.concept: Accessible interfaces consider keyboard access, contrast, labels, focus states, readable content, and assistive technologies.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

pairs.problem: Form fields have no visible labels.
Keyboard users cannot see which control currently has focus.
pairs.answer: Provide a clear visible focus indicator.

pairs.problem: Important information is communicated only through color.
pairs.answer: Use text, icons, or other non-color cues.

pairs.problem: Videos contain spoken information but no captions.
Text and background have insufficient contrast.
pairs.answer: Increase the contrast to improve readability.

pairs.problem: Interactive controls cannot be reached using the keyboard.

activities.title: Developer Handoff Builder
activities.instruction: Assemble the essential assets and specifications needed for implementation.

content.concept: Design handoff communicates components, measurements, states, assets, interactions, and implementation requirements to developers.
